description: Demo: an agent refunds a Razorpay payment through a registered external endpoint, in Razorpay test mode. The target is the Razorpay payment id and parameters.amount is the refund in paise. A refund runs only for a caller holding an authority grant in force for razorpay:refund, within its limits, and with a signed manager approval for that payment covering that amount. The amount is bound to the request, so the agent cannot declare another.

outcome.reason: Refund rejected because the amount must be greater than 0 paise.
Refund authorized with a verified manager approval for this payment and amount, for a caller holding an authority grant in force.
Every refund needs a signed manager approval for this payment, covering this amount, in signals.approvalArtifact, with managerApproved true.
